name.zh: 天才骑士与落第骑士决斗

periods.summary: F-rank Ikki defeats A-rank Stella in a formal duel that decides their shared-room arrangement.
periods.cause: Stella and Ikki cannot agree on dorm rules; Kurono frames a duel as the knightly solution.
periods.process: Stella overwhelms Ikki with flame, power and Calusaritio Salamander. Ikki reads and copies her sword style with Blade Steal, then activates Ittou Shura to break his limits for one minute and strike first.
periods.outcome: Ikki wins with a single decisive blow under fantasy form; both collapse from fatigue or damage.
periods.aftermath: Kurono explains Ikki's family suppression to Stella. Stella accepts living with Ikki, begins respecting him, and calls him by name.
casualties: Ikki suffers severe post-Ittou Shura exhaustion
periods.significance: Establishes Ikki's core fighting style, Stella's respect for him, and their roommate relationship.
